default.description: Used by CLI if not specified

values.description: Possible values (e.g. card faces, die sides)

per_player.description: If true, each player has their own copy

initial_state.description: Starting values for tracked game state. All keys are optional.

flags.description: Named boolean or string flags (e.g. {"first_player_bonus_available": true})

scores.description: Starting scores per player. Defaults to 0 for all if omitted.

custom.description: Any other state the referee needs to track (e.g. hand sizes, deck counts)

setup.description: Ordered steps to set up the game before play begins

turn_structure.description: Ordered phases within a single player's turn

actions.description: Discrete actions a player may take. The referee validates all actions against these definitions.

type.description: Snake_case identifier used in agent JSON responses

description.description: What this action does, in plain language

conditions.description: Preconditions that must be true for this action to be legal

effects.description: What changes in game state when this action is taken

win_conditions.description: Conditions that end the game. Evaluated after each turn.

threshold.description: For score_threshold: score value that triggers win

flag.description: For flag: which flag key to check

value.description: For flag: the value the flag must equal

limit.description: For turn_limit: total turns before game ends

edge_cases.description: Special rulings the referee should apply when standard action rules are ambiguous

situation.description: Describe the ambiguous or exceptional situation
